description: Plan v7 section 8.3 'alternatives-only children that hit and miss'. Each definition contains an alternative that supplies ONLY a nested alternatives list and no translation of its own, selected on gender (LocalizedStringLoader permits translation==null when at least one alternative is present). Delivery.Status deliberately places a LATER sibling alternative (packageCount == 0) that matches the very same context the nested children miss on, and gives the root its own translation, so a miss inside the selected child can be told apart from fall-through to a later sibling AND from falling back to the root translation -- the two ways a port can get DefaultStrings.java:806-810 wrong. The root translation deliberately references no placeholder, so the root path cannot fail for an unrelated reason. Guest.Welcome repeats the shape with a root that has no translation at all. Tiebreakers are null: only 'en' is loaded.

packageCount == 1.translation: One package is on its way to {{recipient}}.

packageCount > 1.translation: {{packageCount}} packages are on their way to {{recipient}}.

recipientGender == GENDER_MASCULINE.translation: A delivery is on its way to {{recipient}}.

Guest.Welcome.commentary: No translation of its own: the root is alternatives-only and so is its first child.
